comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: Mouse button held on a sortable heading, Aqua. No screenshot shows a pressed heading: the spec infers that the fill darkens by about 8%.

pixels.note: pressed fill: #efefef darkened by black at 8% (inferred in the spec)
the next heading keeps the measured fill
column separator at the pressed cell's last point: measured #d5d5d5; the overlay may or may not cover it
bottom border, measured

the next heading keeps the measured fill

comparisons.name: focus-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the sortable heading (one Tab) draws the focus ring inside the cell, Aqua. Inferred: AppKit's headings are not in the tab order.

pixels.note: 3 pt ring inside the top of the cell: the focus ring colour over the measured fill #efefef (computed from the tokens)
fill inside the ring
no ring on the next heading

comparisons.name: focus-resizable-light
comparisons.description: The second Tab reaches the heading that can only be resized: it is the tab stop for Option-Arrow resizing and shows the same ring. Aqua, inferred.

pixels.note: ring inside the second cell (computed from the tokens)
the first heading lost the ring

comparisons.name: focus-not-key-light
comparisons.description: The same Tab in an inactive window: no focus ring (inferred, as for every control in a window that is not key).

pixels.note: no ring: the fill is unchanged in a window that is not key
separator unchanged, measured

comparisons.name: focus-dark
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the sortable heading (one Tab) draws the focus ring inside the cell, Dark Aqua. Inferred: AppKit's headings are not in the tab order.

pixels.note: 3 pt ring inside the top of the cell: the dark focus ring token, rgb(43 168 255) at 50%, over the measured fill #2d2f31 (computed from the tokens; the spec's focus ring measures #2d6c99 on #2f3032)
fill inside the ring, measured in Activity Monitor (spec: table-header)
no ring on the next heading: the measured fill

comparisons.name: focus-resizable-dark
comparisons.description: The second Tab reaches the heading that can only be resized: it is the tab stop for Option-Arrow resizing and shows the same ring. Dark Aqua, inferred.

pixels.note: ring inside the second cell: the dark focus ring token at 50% over the measured fill #2d2f31 (computed from the tokens)
the first heading lost the ring: the measured fill

comparisons.name: focus-not-key-dark
comparisons.description: The same Tab in an inactive window, Dark Aqua: no focus ring (inferred, as for every control in a window that is not key).

pixels.note: no ring: the measured fill is unchanged in a window that is not key

comparisons.name: console-titles-light
comparisons.description: Console's header as Console draws it, Aqua: the translucent variant with its sortable titles placed by the two hooks, 2 pt from the column's edge and half a point up. The crop of console-light. Titles are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: console-titles-drawing-light
comparisons.description: Console's header as Console draws it, Aqua: the same crop with the titles masked, which scores the translucent fill over the content background, the border and the separators.

comparisons.name: console-titles-dark
comparisons.description: Console's header as Console draws it, Dark Aqua: the translucent variant with its sortable titles placed by the two hooks.

comparisons.name: console-titles-drawing-dark
comparisons.description: Console's header as Console draws it, Dark Aqua: the same crop with the titles masked, which scores the translucent fill over the content background, the border and the separators.

comparisons.name: keychain-titles-light
comparisons.description: Keychain Access's header with its sortable titles where Keychain Access has them, placed by the two hooks (3.5 pt from the column's edge, half a point up), and its headings drawn from a list of columns, Aqua. The crop of keychain-light.

comparisons.name: keychain-titles-dark
comparisons.description: Keychain Access's header with its sortable titles where Keychain Access has them, placed by the two hooks, and its headings drawn from a list of columns, Dark Aqua. The crop of keychain-dark.

comparisons.name: translucent-light
comparisons.description: The translucent variant over two backgrounds, Aqua: the content background under its left half and the emphasised selection colour under its right half. No screenshot shows a selected row under Console's header; the fill and its alpha are measured there on the text of an unselected row.

pixels.note: white at 95% over the white content background: Console's header fill, measured (spec: table-header)
white at 95% (measured in Console, computed) over #0164e1 (the measured emphasised selection) is 242, 247, 253.5: what is behind the header shows through; the plain variant would be #ffffff
bottom border, measured in Console (spec: table-header)
column separator at the first cell's last point, measured in Console (spec: table-header); at the seam of the two backgrounds

comparisons.name: translucent-dark
comparisons.description: The translucent variant over two backgrounds, Dark Aqua: as translucent-light.

pixels.note: over Console's content background #1e1f20 the fill is Console's header fill #313131, measured (spec: table-header)

the header's fill at 95% (measured in Console, computed: #323232 fitted, #333333 stored for 8-bit compositing) over #0158d0 (the measured emphasised selection) is 47.6, 51.9, 57.9: what is behind the header shows through; the plain variant would be #313131
bottom border, measured in Console (spec: table-header)
